title: NPDev Customization Provenance Manifest
description: Path A P5.2 (NPDEV_PATH_A_REALIGNMENT_PLAN.md; docs/architecture/NPDEV_BOX_OBJECT_TRUTH_VISION.md's Customization Registry): an OPTIONAL sibling of model.json declaring what/where/why/who for a customization ExtensionInventoryEmitter (P0.3) already discovers by construction -- untrustedExtensionAsset (panel/procedure/widget, P5.1's own untrusted-extension-manifest.json covers identity/source for that one category only), javaHook, inProcessController, pluginPackage. The file itself is optional -- an inventory entry with no matching record here is reported as undeclared, never a generation failure; declaring nothing never blocks creation, only a false claim would.

owner.description: The model element id this record describes -- the same value ExtensionInventoryEmitter's own `owner` field already carries for this customization (a procedure/panel/widget id, a conversion id, or a capability requirement id).

changeSummary.description: What changed -- a short description of the customization itself.

reason.description: Why this customization exists rather than the generated default.

author.description: Who created it -- a name, handle, or agent/session id.

regenerationIntent.description: Declared intent only -- P5.3 is where the generator actually enforces a regeneration conflict outcome against this.

requiresRetest.description: Whether a model/generator change touching this customization's area should trigger a re-test before release.
